name: text/tracking-in
title: Tracking In
desc_vi: Chữ hiện dần, khoảng cách giữa các chữ khép từ rộng về sát, đồng thời nổi nhẹ lên 8 px.
params_vi: duration (0.9 s) · stagger giữa các phần tử (0.1 s) · from / to: giãn chữ đầu / cuối tính theo em (0.28 / 0.02) · reach: nhân cả đường cong (tight 0.6, wide 1.8) · y
notes: Only the motion is ported (the source's tone colour belongs to the film). The source drives a CSS variable --hf-tracking-value read by letter-spacing; here letter-spacing itself is tweened (0.28em -> 0.02em, multiplied by the `reach` param, which replaces the source variables tracking = tight/standard/wide) so the tween is a plain literal one. The source's `rise` variable (subtle 4 px, standard 8, bold 18) is the `y` param. The text lands on letter-spacing 0.02em, which is part of the effect: give the film's text letter-spacing 0.02em if it must match the final layout (the demo does).
